title: 英伟达技术被夸上天：股价却还在挨压，哈塞特市场在重估增长
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The other thing we have to talk about when it comes to this economy is what companies are sort of holding up the economy, or are important for it.
segments.zh: 谈到经济，我们还得聊聊哪些公司在支撑经济，或者对经济至关重要。

segments.en: And NVIDIA has long been talked about one of these ones, and the president's action also probably, you know, lending to this idea too that NVIDIA is of national importance
segments.zh: 英伟达一直被认为是其中之一，总统的行动可能也助长了这种观点，即英伟达对国家具有重要性。

segments.en: to this country. And the selling continues this morning. There is still pain in that stock and concerns about it.
segments.zh: 今早抛售仍在继续。该股仍有压力，市场也有担忧。

segments.en: The president has floated this idea before about maybe taking a stake in NVIDIA, much like Intel.
segments.zh: 总统之前提出过可能入股英伟达，就像英特尔那样。

segments.en: Is that something seriously being considered at the moment?
segments.zh: 目前是否在认真考虑这件事？

segments.en: That's not something that I've discussed with the president. I can say that NVIDIA is a very, very strong company.
segments.zh: 我没和总统讨论过这个。但可以说，英伟达是一家非常非常强的公司。

segments.en: You look at their revenue growth. It's astonishing. And the reason is that they've got a technological advance that is really much better than any
segments.zh: 看看他们的营收增长，非常惊人。原因是他们的技术 advancement 确实远超其他芯片公司。

segments.en: advances of the other chip companies, which makes it possible for the data centers which create like the calculating power for AI to function.
segments.zh: 这使得为AI提供算力的数据中心得以运转。

segments.en: And so there were a company that's being enormously successful because of their technological advantage right now.
segments.zh: 所以这家公司目前因其技术优势而极为成功。

segments.en: And again, when that kind of thing happens, when you see absolutely stratospheric growth, then it's normal for people to wonder, how long can that continue if the growth changes
segments.zh: 再说，当这种情况发生，当你看到爆发式增长时，人们自然会想，如果增长变化，这能持续多久。

segments.en: from this to that? What happens to the value? And I think that markets are assessing those kinds of things right now.
segments.zh: 从这到那？价值会怎样？我认为市场正在评估这类情况。

segments.en: But NVIDIA is a great, great, great company. And if the US is going to win the super intelligence battle, then NVIDIA will be a big reason why.
segments.zh: 但英伟达是一家非常伟大的公司。如果美国要赢得超级智能之争，英伟达将是重要原因。
